description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the set of Samurai bed floor cross members for the Long Wheel Base
Will fit the SWB using only two members, or add the third for extra structure
They fit under the bed floor
Comes Primed and Ready to Prep for Paint!
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Bed Floor Member 1 (Front Bed) 48″ may need to be cut and spliced.
Qty 1 – Bed Floor Member 2 (Mid Bed) 34 3/8″
Qty 1 – Bed Floor Member 3 (Rear Bed) 34 3/8″
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
